shabad.source_english: Codes of Conduct and Other Panthic Sources

en.bdb: Dohra.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਰਕਨ ਸਿਉਂ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾਇਗੀ ਯੁਵਤਿਨ ਸਿਉਂ ਬਹੁ ਬਾਤ॥
verses.translit_en: larakan siau(n) mitraigee yuvatin siau(n) bahu baat||

en.bdb: With children one can be friendly and with young women he can have frequent conversations;

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਜਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤ ਕੀਏ ਕਹੋ ਕਹਾਂ ਕੁਸਲਾਤ॥੪੬॥
verses.translit_en: dhurajan kee sa(n)gat ke'ee kaho kahaa(n) kusalaat||46||

en.bdb: But how can one be happy in the company of the wicked?
One who gains devotion through firm faith in the Guru;
Such a Khalsa shall attain eternal liberation.
Increase wealth, renown, and peaceful rule;
Gain many daughters, sons, and knowledges, O'brother.

verses.gurmukhi: ਏ ਸਬ ਦਾਤ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੀ ਜਾਨੈ॥
verses.translit_en: e sab dhaat guroo kee jaanai||

en.bdb: However, recognize all this to be the boon of the Guru;
Never become egotistical because of them.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੈਂ ਮੇਰਾ ਇਹ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਨ ਕਹੈ॥
verses.translit_en: mai(n) meraa ieh kabahoo(n) na kahai||

en.bdb: Never engross yourself in *Me* or *Mine* (in ego);
Remain ever obedient to the Guru.
What can you achieve if you are weak?
What use is putting rings in your ears if you lack strength?

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਸੁਨੈ ਜਿ ਕਾਨ॥
verses.translit_en: gur kee ni(n)dhaa sunai j kaan||

en.bdb: Listening to the slander of the Guru;
Even the vedas call it a great sin.
All the paths that exist in the world;
Never slander any one of them.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬੈ ਪੰਥ ਹੈਂ ਹਰ ਕੋ ਧਾਮ॥
verses.translit_en: sabai pa(n)th hai(n) har ko dhaam||

en.bdb: All paths revere God;

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਮ ਬਸ ਲੇਹਿ ਹੈਂ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮ॥੫੪॥
verses.translit_en: jim bas leh hai(n) har ko naam||54||

en.bdb: In which God's name is chanted.
Slander, backbiting, and envy;
These are all great afflictions of duality.

verses.gurmukhi: ਇਨ ਕੋ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਦੂਰੀ ਕਰੈ॥
verses.translit_en: ein ko man te dhooree karai||

en.bdb: Keep all these away from your heart;

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗ ਦ੍ਵੈਖ ਨਹਿ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਧਰੈ॥੫੬॥
verses.translit_en: raag dhavaikh neh man te dharai||56||

en.bdb: Do not hold materialistic attachment and duality in your heart.
Whenever Prashad is prepared;

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਦ ਭੇਟ ਬਿਨ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਨ ਖਾਵੈ॥੫੭॥
verses.translit_en: karadh bheT bin kabahoo(n) na khaavai||57||

en.bdb: Do not eat it without performing Karad Bhet (ceremony of blessing food with a knife);
Whoever is given the service of distributing the Prasad;
Should ensure that it is distributed equally among all in the congregation;
Never give unequal shares;
This is the way of Rehitvant Singhs.
It is unlawful to take a bribe.
Never give false testimony.
